    :return: True or False, indicating whether the phone number is valid"""

import re

class RegexUtils:
    def generate_email_pattern(self):
        """Generate regular expression patterns that match email addresses
        :return: string, regular expression patterns that match email addresses"""
        return r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b'

class TestRegexUtils(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_generate_email_pattern(self):
        ru = RegexUtils()
        pattern = ru.generate_email_pattern()
        self.assertEqual(pattern, r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b')

    def test_generate_email_pattern_empty_string(self):
        ru = RegexUtils()
        pattern = ru.generate_email_pattern()
        self.assertNotIn('', pattern)

    def test_generate_email_pattern_no_at_symbol(self):
        ru = RegexUtils()
        pattern = ru.generate_email_pattern()
        self.assertNotIn('@', pattern)

    def test_generate_email_pattern_multiple_at_symbols(self):
        ru = RegexUtils()
        pattern = ru.generate_email_pattern()
        self.assertNotIn('@@', pattern)

    def test_generate_email_pattern_no_domain_extension(self):
        ru = RegexUtils()
        pattern = ru.generate_email_pattern()
        self.assertNotIn('.', pattern)

    def test_generate_email_pattern_invalid_characters(self):
        ru = RegexUtils()
        pattern = ru.generate_email_pattern()
        self.assertNotIn('!', pattern)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
